BiblicalUsage: Rôwmᵉmâh names exaltation, that is praise. It stands in Psalms 149:6: "…God in their mouth, and a twoedged sword…".
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one mention of rôwmᵉmâh is enough, because God wastes no words.
